phone_calendar_create_event.description: Create a calendar event. `start` and `end` are ISO 8601 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-10-24T14:00:00+08:00). For an all-day event pass all_day=true and dates at 00:00. The user must approve the event on the phone before it is saved. Returns the new event's identifier.

all_day.description: Mark the event as all-day. Default false.

calendar.description: Calendar name (title) to put the event in. Default: the default calendar for new events.

end.description: End time, ISO 8601 with a timezone. Must be after start.

start.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

phone_calendar_events.description: List calendar events in a time window. Defaults to the next 7 days starting at 00:00 today. Times are ISO 8601 with a timezone offset (e.g. 2026-10-24T14:00:00+08:00). Returns each event's id, title, start, end, all-day flag, calendar name, location, the first 300 characters of notes and the attendees. Use it to check whether the user is free.

end.description: Window end, ISO 8601. Default: 7 days after start.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, default 50, max 200.

query.description: Only return events whose title, location or notes contain this text.

phone_clipboard_get.description: Read the phone's clipboard as text. iOS may show an "Allow Paste?" prompt the first time, which the user has to confirm. Returns "text" and its character count, or text: null when the clipboard is empty or holds something that is not text.

phone_clipboard_set.description: Replace the phone's clipboard with the given text, for example a link or a draft the user asked for. Overwrites whatever was there.

text.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

phone_contacts_search.description: Search the phone's contacts by name, company, job title, email or phone number. Returns up to `limit` people with their name, company, job title, phone numbers (with labels such as mobile/work), email addresses and birthday (yyyy-MM-dd). Use this to look up a colleague's number before calling or drafting a message.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return, default 10, max 50.

query.description: Text to match against name, company, job title, email or phone number. Matching is case-insensitive and looks for the text anywhere in the field; a phone number matches with or without spaces and dashes. Pass an empty string to get the first contacts in the address book's own order.

phone_device_info.description: Describe the phone: model identifier and name, iOS version, battery percentage and charging state, low power mode, free and total storage in bytes, current network type (wifi/cellular/wired/offline), timezone and locale, and the Persona app's version, build number and build channel (debug/release). Cheap and safe to call when you need context about the device.

phone_health_summary.description: Summarize the user's health data per day. Metrics: steps, distance (meters), active_energy, resting_energy, dietary_energy (kcal, daily totals), protein, carbs, fat (grams, daily totals), heart_rate (bpm, average/min/max over the day), resting_heart_rate (bpm), sleep (hours asleep), weight (kg). Defaults to steps over the last 7 days. Only the requested metrics are read. Days run from local midnight to midnight; today's numbers are partial. Returns one row per day with only the days that have data. Read access is never reported to apps, so an empty result can also mean the user denied read access.

days.description: How many days back from today, default 7, max 90.

phone_location_current.description: Get the phone's current location. Returns latitude, longitude, horizontal accuracy in meters, altitude, the reverse-geocoded address (country, province, city, district, street, formatted address), the device timezone and the timestamp of the fix (ISO 8601). Waits at most 15 seconds for a fix. Only call this when the user asks something that needs their location.

phone_notify.description: Post a notification on the phone. Use it to tell the user about something that happened while they were not looking (a long task finished, a build failed). delay_seconds schedules it a few seconds or minutes later; omit it to notify immediately. The first call asks for notification permission. Returns whether the notification was scheduled.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds from now to deliver it. Default 0 (immediately), max 86400.

phone_photo_get.description: Get one photo as an image so you can look at it (read a screenshot, describe a photo, transcribe a whiteboard). Pass the id from phone_photos_recent. The image is JPEG, at most max_size pixels on the long edge (default 1280, max 2048), quality 0.7. Returns the image plus a short text description.

max_size.description: Longest edge in pixels, default 1280, max 2048.

phone_photos_recent.description: List recent photos and videos, newest first. Each row has the Photos local identifier, creation date (ISO 8601), media type (image/video), pixel width and height, whether it is a screenshot, whether it is a favorite, duration in seconds for videos, and the latitude/longitude where the photo was taken when it is geotagged. Pass an id to phone_photo_get to actually see the image.

days.description: Only assets from the last N days. Default: no limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets, default 20, max 100.
